title: Cushman & Wakefield Houston Office Agency Leasing Team Arranges More Than 40,000 SF of New Leases at 10375 Richmond
summary: Cushman & Wakefield Houston Office Agency Leasing Team Arranges More Than 40,000 SF of New Leases at 10375 Richmond
body_markdown:
10375 Richmond


****


****HOUSTON, September 15, 2026 –** Cushman & Wakefield announced today that it has represented ownership, Millennium Tower LLC, in more than 40,000 square feet of new leasing activity at 10375 Richmond, a 362,849-square-foot Class A office tower in Houston's Westchase Business District. The transactions include new leases with HRSS CPAs, Ranger Energy Services and ITI International. With these transactions, 10375 Richmond has garnered 30% of the new leasing volume in 2026 among vintage Class A buildings in the Westchase submarket.**


**Cushman & Wakefield's JP Hutcheson represented the landlord in all three transactions. HRSS CPAs, a Houston-based accounting firm with a 40-year history, signed a long-term lease for a full floor at the building. The tenant was represented by Lucian Bukowski and Kylee Antweil of Stream Realty Partners. Ranger Energy Services, one of the nation's largest providers of high-specification mobile rig well services, cased-hole wireline services and ancillary oilfield services, leased more than 11,000 square feet. The tenant was represented by John Zivley of Partners. ITI International, a global provider of procurement guidance, technical support and quality assurance services to the energy sector for more than four decades, also signed a new lease at the property. The tenant was represented by Jim Vann of Moody Rambin. In addition, Starwood Land, a Starwood Capital Group company, recently leased space at the property. The tenant was represented by Tyler Reagor of Clark Gaines. Located at the intersection of Richmond Avenue and Beltway 8, 10375 Richmond is a 21-story office tower offering immediate access to Houston's major transportation corridors and premier business districts. The property currently features a renovated lobby and common areas, an executive conference center, a tenant lounge, a window-lined fitness center, covered parking, 24/7 security and on-site property management.**


“The recent leasing velocity at 10375 Richmond reflects the continued demand we are seeing for well-located Class-A office environments that help companies attract and retain talent,” said Hutcheson, Executive Director at Cushman & Wakefield. “With its strategic Westchase location, exceptional access throughout Houston and extensive amenity base, 10375 Richmond continues to stand out in the market. These transactions are another strong indicator of the positive momentum in Houston's office sector and the flight-to-quality trend that remains a driving force behind tenant decision-making.”


Recent investments in the asset include upgrades to the building’s fitness center and common areas, further enhancing the tenant experience.
